## About
Empire Lawn Care is a lawn care and landscaping company based in Arlington. Our crews handle routine mowing, edging and blowing on a weekly or bi-weekly schedule, so your yard stays neat without you spending your weekends on it.
We also take on the bigger jobs: picking and planting flowers and ornamental plants, spreading mulch, weeding out overgrowth, clearing fallen leaves, trimming shrubs and trees, and removing trees and stumps. No job is too small for us.
Your property is a home, and we treat it that way. We take care to keep fixtures and irrigation intact while we work. Customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 87 reviews on Google.

## Services
- Weekly and bi-weekly mowing: Regular mowing visits that include edging and blowing, so your property stays neat and clean.
- Mulch spreading and weeding: We spread mulch, weed out troublesome plants and overgrowth, and remove fallen leaves.
- Planting flowers and plants: Tell us the look you want for your front lawn or backyard and we will pick and plant to match it.
- Shrub trimming and flowerbed weeding: Trimming shrubs and weeding flowerbeds to keep beds tidy.
- Tree trimming and removal: Branch trimming to keep trees healthy, plus tree and stump removal.

## FAQ
Q: Which areas do you serve?
A: We serve Arlington, Mansfield and South Grand Prairie, and we are now serving Midlothian and Venus too.

Q: How often can you mow my lawn?
A: We offer weekly and bi-weekly service, and each visit includes mowing, edging and blowing.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Give us a call or reach out through the contact page and we can talk about what your yard needs.
